dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Mr Nonchalant was surrendered to the care center as a stray, and we have no history on his behavior in a home environment. Mr Nonchalant has shown social and affiliative behavior with staff at the care center, but has also displayed anxiety, a low threshold for arousal, and has been highly reluctant to return to kennel. This has resulted in two bite incidents, where he has bitten and released handler's knees while attempting to escape the kennel, with neither bite breaking skin. Due to these concerns, we recommend placement with an experienced New Hope who can allow for decompression, provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based), and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Mr. Nonchalant
